Question: Assalamualaykum, Can u please give a du'a that my mother and/or I could read for a married woman to stop having an affair with with my brother who is not married? And a du'a for him to break the promise that this woman has asked him to make which is to never get married to any girl?And a du'a to remove this illegitimate love in my brother's heart? And a du'a to make him READ SALAAHS (please!!!), pay zakaat and fast? Answer ID: 25481 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2002/H=683/th=1431) Recite surah Al-fatiha 41 times daily with durood 11-11 times before and after, make dua, blow it on the water, and give him to drink. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
